result.summary: This is a low-speed residential street with a sidewalk provided on at least one side of the roadway. While the environment is generally quiet, it lacks marked pedestrian crossings and features sightline obstructions caused by on-street parking.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers when attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street in the foreground and mid-ground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to narrow the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Marked crosswalks at intersections would provide a designated space for pedestrians and alert drivers to their presence.

result.summary: This residential street lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, most notably sidewalks, forcing people to walk in the roadway. The presence of parked vehicles and the absence of marked crossings or traffic calming measures create a high-risk environment for pedestrians sharing space with motor vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There is no dedicated space for pedestrians, requiring them to walk in the travel lane alongside vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb and driveway entrances create blind spots for drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street and driveways on the left

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, increasing exposure risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or chicanes to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

result.summary: This residential intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a curb ramp, but lacks robust safety controls. The crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and parked vehicles near the corner create potential sightline obstructions for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are heavily worn and barely visible, reducing driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway in the foreground and mid-ground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A red truck is parked very close to the intersection corner, potentially blocking the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace the faded transverse lines with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings to improve conspicuity.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking too close to the crosswalk.

result.summary: A residential intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or clear traffic control. The wide, open geometry and parked vehicles near the corners create long crossing distances and potential sightline obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at this wide intersection leaves pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners can block the visibility between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left curbs near the intersection corners

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers to the crossing location.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance, slow turning traffic, and improve sightlines by preventing parking at the corners.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps to provide accessible transitions between the sidewalk and the roadway.
